options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Specifies the goal of the world.
if your goal is act 5, you need to get to the 3rd area in act 6, kauri fortress, because of zone names.

options.name: Bosses to kill (if Goal is set Defeat Bosses)
options.doc:
This is ignored if Goal isn't set to defeat_bosses. This specifies the number of bosses that need to be defeated
(and for you to pick up their drops) in order for you to goal. This will max out at the number of bosses available in the world.

options.name: Bosses Available
options.doc:
This is also ignored if Goal isn't set to defeat_bosses. Specifies the availability of the bosses in the world.
This will NOT determine how many bosses are available in the world, but rather which bosses can be randomized.
This will choose any (including _very_ difficult bosses if none are selected.)

valid choices: [ "hydra", "phoenix", "chimera", "minotaur", "shaper", "uber_shaper", "elder", "uber_elder",

options.name: Starting Character
options.doc: The starting character for the world. This will determine the class available at the start.

options.name: Ascendancies Available Per Class
options.doc: Specifies the maximum number of available ascendancies per class.

options.name: Allow Unlock of Other Characters
options.doc: Allows unlocking of other characters.

options.name: Usable Starting Gear
options.doc:
Specifies if you should start with the gear that you find in the tutorial, for your starting character.
use this option if you don't want to punch hillock to death.

options.name: Gucci Hobo Mode
options.doc:
Specifies if the world should be in Gucci Hobo Mode, this restricts use of non-unique equipment.
This is an extremely difficult challenge intended for experienced players, and will greatly increase the length of your run.
Expect a very slow start, involving farming early act 1 zones. (not reccomended)

choices.label: Allow One Slot Of Any Rarity
Allow One Slot Of Normal Rarity

options.name: Progressive Gear
options.doc:
Controls whether gear rarity follows a progressive unlock system. Progressive gear is recommended for better game balance and pacing.
When enabled, you'll receive gear upgrades that will increase in rarity.
When disabled, you can receive gear of any rarity (you might find rare items before normal ones).
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle si la rareté des rapports suit un système de déverrouillage progressif. La vitesse progressive est recommandée pour un meilleur équilibre et un meilleur rythme.
Une fois activé, vous recevrez des mises à niveau qui augmenteront en rareté.
Lorsque vous êtes handicapé, vous pouvez recevoir du matériel de toute rareté (vous pouvez trouver des articles rares avant les articles normaux).

options.name: Disable Generation Logic
options.doc:
Disables all generation logic, ignoring any placement rules, and placing items completely randomly. This ignores all other "Minimum Available" Options.
This will likely make your run very difficult, and is not recommended.
options.doc_fr:
Désactive toute logique de génération, ignorant toutes les règles de placement et plaçant les éléments complètement aléatoirement. Cela ignore toutes les autres options « Minimum disponible ».
Cela rendra probablement votre course très difficile, et n'est pas recommandé.

options.name: Gear Unlocks
options.doc: Specifies if gear rarity should be restricted to a certain rarity, unlockable through items found in the multiworld.

choices.label: All Normal And Unique Gear Unlocked

options.name: Minimum Available Gear Upgrades Per Act
options.doc:
Specifies a minimum number of rarity of gear upgrades available per act. (there are 38 total)
This will be ignored if the "Gear Upgrades" option is turned off.

options.name: Restricted Flasks
options.doc:
Specifies if flasks should be restricted, unlockable through items found in the multiworld.
You may equip up to 5 flasks of a given rarity, and can unlock more flasks of a rarity through items.

options.name: Minimum Available Flask Slots Per Act
options.doc:
Specifies a minimum number of available flask slots per act. (there are 5 total)
This will be ignored if the "Flask Slots" option is turned off.

options.name: Restricted Linked Support Gem
options.doc: Specifies if the number of linked support gem slots you can use in gear should be restricted, unlockable through items found in the multiworld.

options.name: Minimum Available Support Gem Slots Per Act
options.doc:
Specifies a minimum number of available linked support gem slots per act. (there are 22 total)
This will be ignored if the "Support Gem Slot Upgrades" option is turned off.

options.name: Restricted Passive Skill Points
options.doc: Specifies if passive skill points should be restricted, unlockable through items found in the multiworld.

options.name: Leveling Up as location checks
options.doc: Specifies if leveling up be considered "locations".

options.name: Area visits as location checks
options.doc:
Specifies if reaching areas (zones) should be considered "locations".
Only areas up to the goal act are included.

options.name: Restricted Skill Gems
options.doc: Specifies if skill gems should be restricted, unlockable through items found in the multiworld.

options.name: Minimum Available Skill Gem Slots Per Act
options.doc:
Specifies the minimum number of usable skill gems placed by the generator per act.
Higher values will place more relevant skill gems early on

options.name: Restricted Support Gems
options.doc: Specifies if skill gems should be restricted, unlockable through items found in the multiworld.

options.name: Minimum Usable Support Gems Per Act
options.doc: Specifies the minimum number of usable support gems (by character level) placed by the generator per act.

options.name: Enable TTS
options.doc:
Enable Text-to-Speech (TTS). If using other loot filter sounds, this option will still generate TTS audio files for invalid state warnings.
If this is disabled, this will ignore Loot Filter Sounds if set to TTS.
If TTS is enabled, the client will generate audio files for item drops that are not already present,
This may take some time initially, but will speed as audio files are generated and saved.
options.doc_fr:
Activer Text-to-Speech (TTS). Si vous utilisez d'autres sons de filtre à butin, cette option générera toujours des fichiers audio TTS pour les avertissements d'état invalide.
Si c'est désactivé, cela ignorera les sons de filtres si configurés sur TTS.
Si TTS est activé, le client va générer des fichiers audio pour les chutes d'éléments qui ne sont pas déjà présents, Cela peut prendre un certain temps initialement, mais va accélérer comme les fichiers audio sont générés et enregistrés.
